description: Infrastructure adapters behind the frozen seams: internal/connect (Slice B Registry + postgres & rest connectors + timeout resilience envelope + classified errors + SecretProvider), internal/decision (Slice C Evaluator backed by zen-go/v2 behind the cgo/!cgo split with the (id,version) compiled cache), and internal/config (in-memory config.Store seeded from JSON). These are the impure edges the interpreter reaches through Deps. Depends on FEAT-001 for the observ Deps types and the established error-classification pattern. Realizes docs/lld/slice-b-connections.md, docs/lld/slice-c-zen-auth.md §1-2, and the config.Store contract.
steps: Read docs/.agents/tasks/context.json and this file FIRST. Then read docs/lld/slice-b-connections.md, docs/lld/slice-c-zen-auth.md (ESPECIALLY the '>>> zen-go v2 mapping' block), internal/zenspike/zen.go + internal/zenspike/zen_stub.go (the proven binding to mirror), and internal/zenspike/testdata/order.jdm.json.

internal/connect/errors.go: ConnError{Class ErrClass, Key, Op string, cause error} with ErrClass Timeout/NotFound/Validation/Upstream/Internal, Error()/Unwrap(), and classification helpers; never put secret values in the error.

internal/connect/secret.go: SecretProvider interface (Resolve, Watch) + Secret type (String()/MarshalJSON redact to "***", Reveal() []byte for drivers) + an env-backed provider resolving env:NAME refs.

internal/connect/resilience.go: ResiliencePolicy is the contract type; mergePolicy(base, override *ResiliencePolicy) ResiliencePolicy doing FIELD-LEVEL merge (override non-zero wins — node wins, AC-7). Apply policy.Timeout via context.WithTimeout as the OUTERMOST wrap. Retry + breaker are minimal/stubbed with a clear TODO comment (thin slice ships timeout-only) but Operation.Override MUST change the effective timeout.

internal/connect/client.go: resilientClient wrapping an inner driver Client; Execute(ctx, op) merges policy (connection default + op.Override), applies the timeout, calls inner.Execute, and returns classified errors; Close() closes the inner client.

internal/connect/registry.go: registry implementing connect.Registry — Client(ctx,key) returns the SAME *resilientClient per key (map read, pointer identity, AC-5); builds one client per ConnectionDef at New via the type->Connector factory, resolving SecretRef; Reload(ctx, defs) reconciles (added/removed/changed/unchanged) under a write lock; HealthCheck(ctx) fans out cheap probes. New(connectors, secrets, tracer, logger).

internal/connect/drivers/postgres.go: pgConnector (Type 'postgres', Open builds a pgxpool from Settings + resolved secret) and pgClient.Execute handling Kind 'query' ([]map[string]any rows) and 'exec' ({rowsAffected}) with POSITIONAL params ($1..) ONLY — never string-interpolated; a SELECT under exec or mutation under query is a Validation error; map pgx no-rows to NotFound, ctx deadline to Timeout, connection reset to Upstream.

internal/connect/drivers/rest.go: restConnector (Type 'rest' and alias 'http', Open builds one shared *http.Client with a tuned Transport; http.Client.Timeout left unset so the resilience ctx governs) and restClient.Execute handling Kind 'http' (method/path/headers/query/body -> {status,headers,body}); map 4xx to Validation/NotFound, 5xx/429 to Upstream, ctx deadline to Timeout.
internal/connect/drivers/registry.go: compile-time type->Connector factory table so a new type is a new file, no Registry change (AC-8).

internal/connect/registry_test.go: unit tests with a FAKE Connector/Client (counting Open calls, injecting faults) — Client(key) returns the same instance N times (pointer identity, AC-5) and Open called exactly once per key; mergePolicy with a node timeout override beats the connection default and a no-override op keeps the default (AC-7, assert elapsed timing against a slow fake); unsupported Kind => Validation.
internal/decision/errors.go: classification mapping (loader-miss => NotFound, malformed JDM => Validation, ctx cancel => Timeout, recovered panic => Internal, stub => Validation).
internal/decision/loader.go: JDMLoader port (LoadJDM(ctx, env, jdmID) (jdm []byte, version int, err error)).

internal/decision/cache.go: compiledCache keyed by compiledKey{ID string, Version int}; getOrCompile with double-checked locking so one compile per (id,version); a Close path that frees graphs on eviction/shutdown.

internal/decision/zen_cgo.go (//go:build cgo): the ONLY import of github.com/gorules/zen-go/v2. Engine implements decision.Evaluator: Evaluate(ctx, jdmID, input) resolves env from ctx, LoadJDM, getOrCompile, then Compiled.Eval. Mirror internal/zenspike/zen.go EXACTLY: zen.NewEngine(zen.EngineConfig{}), eng.CreateDecision(jdm) to compile into the Compiled adapter, Compiled.Eval honors ctx BEFORE and AFTER dec.Evaluate(input) (no ctx arg; no in-eval cancel), unmarshals resp.Result (json.RawMessage) into map[string]any, Compiled.Close() -> dec.Dispose(); add Engine.Close() calling eng.Dispose() + cache close for cmd/engine graceful shutdown.

internal/decision/zen_stub.go (//go:build !cgo): same package API; constructors succeed in shape but Evaluate/compile return a Validation-class 'built without CGO; ZEN unavailable' error so a non-CGO build COMPILES but never silently no-ops (mirror internal/zenspike/zen_stub.go).

internal/decision/evaluator_cgo_test.go (//go:build cgo): load internal/zenspike/testdata/order.jdm.json bytes via a fake JDMLoader; assert determinism (same (id,version,input) => byte-identical output across repeats) and that getOrCompile compiles once per (id,version) and recompiles for a new version (compile counter via a fake compiler or an instrumented path).

internal/config/store.go: in-memory store implementing config.Store (ActiveFlow(env,method,path) FlowVersion, GetJDM(env,id) (bytes,version), Connections(env) []ConnectionDef, PutFlowVersion, SetActive, Ping) over maps/RWMutex.

internal/config/seed.go + internal/config/testdata/seed.json: load a JSON seed at startup into the store. seed.json carries the thin-slice flow tree (Trigger -> Action(pg read SELECT amount,status FROM orders WHERE id=$1) -> Condition(jdmId=order, inputs amount+status, trueKey=expedite, falseKey=standard) -> {Action(POST /expedite) -> Set(shipping from decision) -> Response ; Action(POST /standard) -> Set(shipping) -> Response}), the order JDM bytes (same decision-table as internal/zenspike/testdata/order.jdm.json), and two ConnectionDefs: 'orders-pg' (postgres) and 'ship-rest' (rest). Keep placeholders for pg DSN + rest baseURL that the integration test (FEAT-003) overrides.
internal/config/store_test.go: load the seed and assert ActiveFlow('','GET','/orders/{id}') returns the tree, GetJDM returns bytes+version, Connections returns both defs, Ping returns nil.
acceptance_criteria: connect test proves one pooled client per key (pointer identity, AC-5) and node-override timeout wins over the connection default (AC-7).
decision test proves deterministic output and one compile per (id,version) using the committed order JDM.
config test proves the seeded flow resolves via ActiveFlow and the JDM + connections load.
findings:
DONE. Verification all pass: `CGO_ENABLED=1 go build ./internal/connect/... ./internal/decision ./internal/config` exit 0; `CGO_ENABLED=0 go build ./internal/decision` exit 0 (the !cgo stub compiles); `CGO_ENABLED=1 go test ./internal/connect/... ./internal/decision ./internal/config` all pass (connect: pointer-identity AC-5 + Open-once-per-key, timeout-override-wins AC-7 incl. elapsed timing vs a slow fake + no-override default held, field-level mergePolicy, unknown-key/unsupported-kind => Validation, Reload add/keep/remove reconcile; decision: cache one-compile-per-(id,version)+recompile-on-new-version via counting compiler, cache Close frees graphs, and under cgo the REAL zen-go binding proves determinism (byte-identical across repeats and across two Engine instances), expedited/standard branches, and compile-once-per-version through the real engine; config: seed resolves ActiveFlow + GetJDM bytes/version + both ConnectionDefs + Ping, unknown route => NotFound); `CGO_ENABLED=1 go vet ...` clean. `go mod tidy` added two already-cached indirect deps for pgxpool (jackc/puddle/v2, golang.org/x/sync).

`go mod tidy` was required (pgxpool pulls jackc/puddle/v2 + golang.org/x/sync as indirect). Both were already in the module cache; no new download. go.sum unchanged.

=== EXPORTED SIGNATURES later features (FEAT-003 wiring + cmd/engine) depend on ===
-- internal/connect --
func New(connectors []connect.Connector, defs []connect.ConnectionDef, secrets connect.SecretProvider, tracer observ.Tracer, log observ.Logger) (*registry, error)  // *registry is unexported but satisfies connect.Registry; also has (*registry) Close() error for graceful shutdown. A nil secrets defaults to the env provider; nil tracer/log tolerated. New OPENS one client per def eagerly and returns a classified error (and closes partially-opened pools) if any Open fails.
func NewEnvSecretProvider() connect.SecretProvider  // resolves 'env:NAME' (or a bare NAME); unset var => Validation; empty ref => empty Secret.
func NewConnError(class ErrClass, key, op, msg string, cause error) *ConnError  // exported ctor used by the drivers subpackage; never put a secret in msg/cause.
connect.Connector interface { Type() string; Open(ctx, ConnectionDef) (Client, error) }  // NEWLY DECLARED by FEAT-002 (connector.go). Registry injects the resolved Secret on the Open ctx; a driver reads it via connect.SecretFrom(ctx) (Secret, bool) and connect.WithSecret(ctx, Secret).
connect.Secret: NewSecret([]byte) Secret; (Secret) String()="***"; MarshalJSON="***"; Reveal() []byte; IsZero() bool.
connect.ErrClass consts Internal/Timeout/NotFound/Validation/Upstream; sentinels ErrInternal/ErrTimeout/ErrNotFound/ErrValidation/ErrUpstream (errors.Is matches a *ConnError by class). mergePolicy is UNEXPORTED; resilience ships TIMEOUT-ONLY (default 5s when unset) applied as the OUTERMOST context.WithTimeout; Operation.Override.Timeout wins field-level (AC-7). Retry/breaker are stubbed with a TODO in client.go/resilience.go.
-- internal/connect/drivers --
func drivers.All() []connect.Connector  // the compile-time factory set: postgres + rest + rest-under-'http' alias. Adding a type = new file + one entry here (AC-8).
postgres: Kind 'query' => []map[string]any rows (via rows.Values()+FieldDescriptions), Kind 'exec' => {rowsAffected int64}, Kind 'ping' => {ok:true}. POSITIONAL params only (payload keys 'sql' string + 'params' []any). SELECT-under-exec and mutation-under-query => Validation. pgx.ErrNoRows=>NotFound, ctx deadline=>Timeout, net error / pg 5xx => Upstream, pg 42xxx => Validation. DSN from settings 'dsn' or host/port/database/user/sslmode; password injected onto cfg.ConnConfig.Password from the Secret (never in the DSN string). pool.maxConns/minConns honored.
rest: Type 'rest' (and alias 'http' via a second connector instance), Kind 'http' => {status,headers map[string]any,body any}, Kind 'ping' => GET baseURL/. http.Client.Timeout UNSET (ctx governs). 404=>NotFound, other 4xx=>Validation, 5xx/429=>Upstream, ctx deadline / net timeout=>Timeout. payload: method/path/headers/query(map[string]string)/body(JSON). Shared tuned Transport.
-- internal/decision --
func New(loader decision.JDMLoader, opts ...Option) *Engine  // SAME signature on both the cgo and !cgo lane. Options: WithLogger(observ.Logger), WithTracer(observ.Tracer), WithEnvFunc(func(ctx) string).
(*Engine) Evaluate(ctx, jdmID string, input map[string]any) (map[string]any, error)  // satisfies decision.Evaluator; resolves env via EnvFromContext(ctx) by default (loader miss=>NotFound, malformed JDM/bad input=>Validation, ctx deadline=>Timeout).
(*Engine) Close() error  // frees the (id,version) compiled cache + the zen engine; cmd/engine must call on graceful shutdown.
decision.JDMLoader interface { LoadJDM(ctx, env, jdmID string) (jdm []byte, version int, err error) }  // satisfied by a thin adapter over config.Store.GetJDM.
decision.WithEnv(ctx, env) context.Context + decision.EnvFromContext(ctx) string  // httpapi/middleware stamps the request env so per-env JDM resolution works (ADR-006). Empty env is the thin-slice default.
decision.Compiled interface { Eval(ctx, input) (map[string]any, error); Close() }  // internal adapter; !cgo lane: New succeeds but compile/Eval return a Validation-class 'built without CGO; ZEN unavailable' error.
decision.ErrClass consts Internal/Timeout/NotFound/Validation; sentinels ErrInternal/ErrTimeout/ErrNotFound/ErrValidation.
-- internal/config --
func NewMemStore() *memStore  // satisfies config.Store; empty.
func LoadSeed(path string) (*memStore, error)  // reads+decodes a seed JSON file (Validation on failure).
func SeedFromBytes(raw []byte) (*memStore, error).
config.Store interface (ActiveFlow/GetJDM/Connections/PutFlowVersion/SetActive/Ping) exactly per lld-contracts; config.FlowVersion{FlowID,Version,Method,Path,Tree flow.Node,Fixtures []FlowFixture} (config imports flow one-directionally, no cycle). config.ErrClass Internal/NotFound/Validation + sentinels.

=== SEED FILE (internal/config/testdata/seed.json) — the thin-slice route + keys FEAT-003 integration must override ===
Active route: env "" (empty), GET /orders/{id}, flowId 'orders-expedite' v1. Tree: trigger(input.params=[id]) -> action id 'read-order' conn 'orders-pg' Kind query sql 'SELECT amount, status FROM orders WHERE id=$1' params ['{{input.id}}'] saveAs 'order' -> condition id 'classify' jdmId 'order' input [order.amount, order.status] trueKey 'expedited' falseKey 'standard' -> children action id 'expedited' (conn 'ship-rest' POST /expedite) and action id 'standard' (conn 'ship-rest' POST /standard), each -> set targetPath 'shipping' from 'decision.body.shipping' -> response status 200. JDM id 'order' v1 carries the SAME decision table as internal/zenspike/testdata/order.jdm.json (amount>1000 && status=='paid' => 'expedited' else 'standard').
Connection keys: 'orders-pg' (type postgres, settings.dsn placeholder postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/orders?sslmode=disable + pool.maxConns/minConns) and 'ship-rest' (type rest, settings.baseURL placeholder http://127.0.0.1:0). FEAT-003 MUST override orders-pg's dsn with the ephemeral-postgres DSN and ship-rest's baseURL with the httptest.Server URL (mutate the ConnectionDef Settings before connect.New, or edit the seed in the test).
SEED-vs-HANDLER CAVEAT for FEAT-003: ConditionSpec has NO branch-field mapping; flow's chooseBranch picks trueKey only when the decision output has out["branch"]==trueKey OR truthy out["result"]. The order JDM returns {"shipping":"expedited|standard"} (no 'branch'/'result'), so a raw decision output falls to falseKey. The condition selects a CHILD by matching child.ID to the chosen key (findChild). FEAT-003 must bridge the decision output to a branch key the condition understands (e.g. an Evaluator/adapter that sets out["branch"] from the JDM's 'shipping', or inputs projected so 'result' is truthy) — this is Slice A/E wiring, not a FEAT-002 concern. The two child action IDs are already 'expedited'/'standard' to match trueKey/falseKey.

=== Operation payload shape ===
flow.ActionSpec.Operation is connect.Operation with exported JSON fields Kind/Payload/Override/IdempotencyKey/Required (capitalized in the seed because connect.Operation has no json tags). actionHandler maps a ResilienceOverride.TimeoutMS onto op.Override.Timeout.
